description:
In German paragraphs, the punctuation family follows Duden typography instead of the English bans. The spaced Gedankenstrich passes, with a density rule at the threshold from the catalog (humanizer-de DASH_CLUSTER, 5 dashes and 15 per 1000 words, to confirm by measurement). The em dash stays banned. German quotes „…“ and ‚…‘ pass, straight quotes and English quotes report. The Ergänzungsstrich passes, a word ending in a hyphen before und, oder, or bis (decision Q22). Also apostrophe, ellipsis, and colon or semicolon density. Source is the typography section of docs/research/2026-09-30-german-style-catalog.md.

Acceptance.
1. `Ein- und Ausgang` raises no spaced_hyphen finding in German text and still raises one in English text.
2. A spaced Gedankenstrich passes until the density threshold.
3. English paragraphs keep today's punctuation behavior.
title: German typography rules after the Duden
